pairs.target: dìèrtiān zǎochén , tǎ wéi xiàlóu shí , zhǎngguì zhèng bǎ dài jì de xìndài jiāogěi chēfū .
pairs.english: The next morning, as Tavi came downstairs, the innkeeper was handing the outgoing mailbag to the driver.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天早晨，塔维下楼时，掌柜正把代寄的信袋交给车夫。

pairs.target: tā rènchū zìjǐ zuóyè zhā de xìshéng , jǔshǒu dǎlegè zhāohū , cái qù hòuyuàn zhǎo yù hé .
pairs.english: He recognized the thin cord he had tied last night, raised a hand in greeting, then went to the back courtyard to find Yuhe.
pairs.hanzi: 他认出自己昨夜扎的细绳，举手打了个招呼，才去后院找郁禾。

pairs.target: jīnrì yàoshù chē , búyòng jiè xìng .
pairs.english: Today they would count carts, with no property borrowing.
pairs.hanzi: 今日要数车，不用借性。

pairs.target: yù hé jiāng yíkuài báobǎn fēnchéng jǐ lán , ràng tā jì zhuǎnwānchù měicì tíng le duōjiǔ , zìjǐ dào lìngyìtóu jì bēilǒu hé bùxíng de rén .
pairs.english: Yuhe divided a thin board into columns, telling him to record how long each stop at the bend lasted; she would count basket carriers and pedestrians at the other end.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾将一块薄板分成几栏，让他记转弯处每次停了多久，自己到另一头记背篓和步行的人。

pairs.target: liǎngchù tóngshí jì , wǔhòu cái hǎo duì shàng .
pairs.english: Recording both places at once would let them match the records in the afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 两处同时记，午后才好对上。

pairs.target: luó dí dài zhe fěnxiàn , xiān bǎ zuórì nuó guò de lùpái jiǎo biān chóngxīn huàqīng , shěngde tānzi bǎikāi hòu yòu bǎ chē yǐncuò .
pairs.english: Luodi brought a chalk line and first remarked the ground beside the sign moved yesterday, so that carts would not be misdirected again once the stalls were set up.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻带着粉线，先把昨日挪过的路牌脚边重新划清，省得摊子摆开后又把车引错。

pairs.target: zuìxiān lái de sānliàng chē dōu guò dé shùn .
pairs.english: The first three carts all passed smoothly.
pairs.hanzi: 最先来的三辆车都过得顺。

pairs.target: dìsìliàng zǎi zhe cháng mùxiāng , dào le wān qián , què chíchí bùkěn zhuǎn .
pairs.english: The fourth carried a long wooden crate and reached the bend, but kept refusing to turn.
pairs.hanzi: 第四辆载着长木箱，到了弯前，却迟迟不肯转。

pairs.target: chēfū tiàoxiàlái liáng le liǎngbù , shuō zìjǐ yào qù shàngtóu de cāng mén , zhèlǐ xià huò , hái dé zài gù rén tái yíduàn .
pairs.english: The driver jumped down and paced out two steps, saying he needed the warehouse entrance above; unloading here would mean hiring people to carry the goods farther.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫跳下来量了两步，说自己要去上头的仓门，这里下货，还得再雇人抬一段。

pairs.target: shū yàn tīngjiàn zhēngzhí , cóng jiēkǒu guòlái .
pairs.english: Shuyan heard the argument and came over from the street entrance.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚听见争执，从街口过来。

pairs.target: chēfū dìgěi tā yìzhāng chūn shì tōnghuò de zhǔn dān , shàng tóugài zhe hóng yìn .
pairs.english: The driver handed her a permit to bring goods into the spring market, stamped with a red seal.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫递给她一张春市通货的准单，上头盖着红印。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn yìn , chàdiǎn yǐwéi lùpái gāi shōu le .
pairs.english: Seeing the seal, Tavi almost thought the sign should be removed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见印，差点以为路牌该收了。

pairs.target: shū yàn jiāng zhǐ fān píng , zhǐ gěi chēfū kàn : " xǔ nǐ jìn shì , búshì xǔ zhèliàng chē cóng suǒyǒu lùkǒu guò .
pairs.english: Shuyan flattened the paper and pointed it out to the driver. “Permission for you to enter the market doesn't mean this cart can pass through every entrance.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚将纸翻平，指给车夫看：“许你进市，不是许这辆车从所有路口过。

pairs.target: shàngmiàn de cháng kuà hái fēng zhe , nǐ yào zǒu cāng hòu nàduàn , yě dé xiān kàn nàbiān néng bunéng zhuǎn . "
pairs.english: The long span above is still closed. If you want the stretch behind the warehouses, we first need to see whether you can turn there.”
pairs.hanzi: 上面的长跨还封着，你要走仓后那段，也得先看那边能不能转。”

pairs.target: " wǒ qùnián zǒuguò . "
pairs.english: “I used it last year.”
pairs.hanzi: “我去年走过。”

pairs.target: " qùnián nǐ lā de búshì zhège xiāngzǐ . "
pairs.english: “Last year you weren't hauling this crate.”
pairs.hanzi: “去年你拉的不是这个箱子。”

pairs.target: chēfū méi zài zhēng xiāngzǐ , què yě bùkěn bān .
pairs.english: The driver stopped arguing about the crate but still refused to move it.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫没再争箱子，却也不肯搬。

pairs.target: tā shuō mùxiāng lǐ shì chāikāi zhuāng hǎo de zhī jià , láihuí tái , zhuànghuài yíchù , jīnnián chūn shì jiù zhī gòu péi .
pairs.english: He said the wooden crate held a disassembled weaving frame packed for transport. If carrying it back and forth damaged one part, this spring market would earn him only enough to pay for it.
pairs.hanzi: 他说木箱里是拆开装好的织架，来回抬，撞坏一处，今年春市就只够赔。

pairs.target: tā cóng chēyán chōuchū yíkuài diànbù , lùchū dǐxià yǐjīng liè le biān de jiù mùtiáo . búshì bǎi gěi tāmen kàn de xīn shāng .
pairs.english: He pulled a pad of cloth from the cart's edge, exposing old wooden slats already split along the edges underneath. This was no fresh damage staged for their benefit.
pairs.hanzi: 他从车沿抽出一块垫布，露出底下已经裂了边的旧木条。不是摆给他们看的新伤。

pairs.target: wéizhe kàn de rén jiànjiàn duō qǐlái .
pairs.english: The watching crowd gradually grew.
pairs.hanzi: 围着看的人渐渐多起来。

pairs.target: mài suān guǒ de lǎorén cuī tā ràngkāi , shuō hòutou yǐ yāzhù zìjǐ de huò .
pairs.english: The elderly sour-fruit seller urged him to move aside, saying his own goods were now blocked behind.
pairs.hanzi: 卖酸果的老人催他让开，说后头已压住自己的货。

pairs.target: yígè tì cāng xíng pǎotuǐ de niánqīngrén jǐjìnlái , wèn shū yàn néng bunéng xiān liú shànglù gěi dàchē , shì sàn yǐhòu zài bǎ lán nuó huíqù .
pairs.english: A young runner for the warehouse firms squeezed in and asked Shuyan whether they could reserve the upper road for big carts first, moving the barriers back after the market.
pairs.hanzi: 一个替仓行跑腿的年轻人挤进来，问舒砚能不能先留上路给大车，市散以后再把栏挪回去。

pairs.target: jǐjiā cāng xíng kěn chū bān lán de qián .
pairs.english: Several warehouse firms were willing to pay for moving the barriers.
pairs.hanzi: 几家仓行肯出搬栏的钱。

pairs.target: " nà mǎi wán dōngxī de rén zěnme huílái ? " bēilǒu nǚrén zhèng cóng shíjiē shànglái , jiāng lǒu fàngzài xī qián xiē le kǒuqì ,
pairs.english: “Then how will people get back after shopping?” The basket-carrying woman was coming up the stone steps. She set her basket in front of her knees to catch her breath.
pairs.hanzi: “那买完东西的人怎么回来？”背篓女人正从石阶上来，将篓放在膝前歇了口气，

pairs.target: " shànglù yì wéi , wǒmen yòu dé cóng chēlún pángbiān zuàn . "
pairs.english: “Close off the upper road and we'll have to squeeze beside the cart wheels again.”
pairs.hanzi: “上路一围，我们又得从车轮旁边钻。”

pairs.target: niánqīngrén shuō kěyǐ xiānràngrén xià , chē zài shàng , huà shuō dào yíbàn , shēnhòu biàn yǒurén jiào tā qù kàn hòutou .
pairs.english: The young man said they could let people down first and carts up afterward, but halfway through, someone behind him called him to look farther back.
pairs.hanzi: 年轻人说可以先让人下，车再上，话说到一半，身后便有人叫他去看后头。

pairs.target: dìèrliàng cháng xiāng chē dào le , chēfū bùkěn dǎotuì , dǎo búshì chěng qì , chē hòu yǐjīng zhàn mǎn le rén .
pairs.english: A second long-crate cart had arrived. Its driver would not reverse, not out of stubbornness: people already filled the space behind the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 第二辆长箱车到了，车夫不肯倒退，倒不是逞气，车后已经站满了人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ bǎn jiá jìn yèxià , gēn luó dí qù qīng chū dǎochē de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi tucked the board under his arm and went with Luodi to clear space for reversing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把板夹进腋下，跟罗荻去清出倒车的地方。

pairs.target: luó dí ràng tā bié tuī xiāngzǐ , xiān jiào wéiguān de rén zhàn dào pù yánxià .
pairs.english: Luodi told him not to push the crate, but first ask the spectators to stand under the shop eaves.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻让他别推箱子，先叫围观的人站到铺檐下。

pairs.target: liǎng rén nuókāi kōng kuāng , jièlái liǎnggēn duǎn mùzuò tíng dǎng , chēfū zìjǐ qiān zhe shēngkǒu tuì le bàngè chēshēn .
pairs.english: The two moved empty baskets aside and borrowed two short timbers as stops, while the driver led his animal back half a cart's length himself.
pairs.hanzi: 两人挪开空筐，借来两根短木作停挡，车夫自己牵着牲口退了半个车身。

pairs.target: tuì dé bù duō , què zhōngyú ràng shíjiē kǒu lùchū lái .
pairs.english: It was not far, but it finally cleared the entrance to the stone steps.
pairs.hanzi: 退得不多，却终于让石阶口露出来。

pairs.target: yíwèi lǎorén cóng nàlǐ xiàlái , cháo tāmen diǎndiǎntóu , suíjí mà le yíjù jīnrì mài yú de zěnme hái méi dào .
pairs.english: An old man came down that way, nodded to them, then complained about why today's fish seller still had not arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 一位老人从那里下来，朝他们点点头，随即骂了一句今日卖鱼的怎么还没到。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rěnbúzhù xiào , shǒulǐ de báobǎn què bèi hàn jìnchū yíkuài àn yìn .
pairs.english: Tavi could not help laughing, though sweat had soaked a dark patch into the thin board in his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忍不住笑，手里的薄板却被汗浸出一块暗印。

pairs.target: dào le wǔhòu , tāmen cái huí kèzhàn duìshù .
pairs.english: Only in the afternoon did they return to the inn to compare the counts.
pairs.hanzi: 到了午后，他们才回客栈对数。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng zhuōbiān duō le yìfēng lái zhǐ , shì zhènshàng jǐjiā cāng xíng liánmíng sòngdào hé lù suǒ , zhuǎngěi xiànchǎng de .
pairs.english: There was a new letter beside Ruan Heng's desk, sent jointly by several of the town's warehouse firms to the Joint Routes Office and forwarded to the site.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡桌边多了一封来纸，是镇上几家仓行联名送到合路所、转给现场的。

pairs.target: chūn shì hòu de dìyīpī shānhuò yǐjīng zài lùshang , zhǐ shàng qǐng tāmen xiān bào shàngcéng huò lù huīfù shǐyòng de kěnéng , miǎnde cuòguò zhěngjì de shōuhuò .
pairs.english: The first mountain produce after the spring market was already on its way. The letter asked them to report first on whether the upper freight route could reopen, so they would not miss an entire season's deliveries.
pairs.hanzi: 春市后的第一批山货已经在路上，纸上请他们先报上层货路恢复使用的可能，免得错过整季的收货。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ zǎoshàng de mùxiāng : " suǒyǐ wǒmen yuánlái kàn de zhè yíduàn , yào wǎnghòu fàng ? "
pairs.english: Tavi thought of the morning's crate. “So the stretch we were originally inspecting gets put back?”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起早上的木箱：“所以我们原来看的这一段，要往后放？”

pairs.target: " tāmen xīwàng zhèyàng . " ruǎn héng shuō .
pairs.english: “That's what they want,” Ruan Heng said.
pairs.hanzi: “他们希望这样。”阮衡说。

pairs.target: tā jiāng zhǐ dìgěi yù hé , méiyǒu xiān zhéqǐlái ,
pairs.english: He handed the paper to Yuhe without folding it away first.
pairs.hanzi: 他将纸递给郁禾，没有先折起来，

pairs.target: " cāng lǐ yǒu huò , tāmen yào wèn , méishénme bùnéng wèn de . kě zhè búshì xīn de wěituō . xiān bǎ liǎngbiān de shì fēnkāi xiě . "
pairs.english: “The warehouses have goods. They want to ask; they're entitled to. But this isn't a new commission. Write the two matters separately first.”
pairs.hanzi: “仓里有货，他们要问，没什么不能问的。可这不是新的委托。先把两边的事分开写。”

pairs.target: yù hé bǎ shàngwǔ liǎngzhāng jìlù tān zài yíchù .
pairs.english: Yuhe spread the morning's two records together.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾把上午两张记录摊在一处。

pairs.target: chē zhī shù le shíjǐliàng , bēilǒu hé bùxíng de rén què yǒu yìbǎiduōgè .
pairs.english: They had counted only a dozen or so carts, but over a hundred basket carriers and pedestrians.
pairs.hanzi: 车只数了十几辆，背篓和步行的人却有一百多个。

pairs.target: yǒu de rén láihuí suànle liǎngcì , bùnéng nálái dāng yìbǎiduō hù , dàn tāmen děng chē de shíchén shì zhēnde .
pairs.english: Some people had been counted twice, coming and going; that did not make a hundred households, but the time they spent waiting for carts was real.
pairs.hanzi: 有的人来回算了两次，不能拿来当一百多户，但他们等车的时辰是真的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng nà liàng cháng xiāng chēquān chūlái , xiěmíng zài nǎlǐ tíngzhù , xiāngzǐ wèishénme bùnéng suíbiàn xiè .
pairs.english: Tavi circled the long-crate cart and wrote down where it had stopped and why the crate could not simply be unloaded.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将那辆长箱车圈出来，写明在哪里停住，箱子为什么不能随便卸。

pairs.target: tā bùxiǎng ràng tā zài zhǐ shàng zhī shèng yígè àishì de jìhào .
pairs.english: He did not want it reduced on paper to a mark meaning only an obstruction.
pairs.hanzi: 他不想让它在纸上只剩一个碍事的记号。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng lìng qǐ yíyè , qǐng hé lù suǒ quèrèn shàngcéng diàochá de rénshǒu hé fànwéi , yǎnqián de tōngxíng jìlù zhào yuánlái de rènwu sòng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng began a separate page asking the Joint Routes Office to confirm staffing and scope for an upper-level survey; the current passage records would be sent under the original assignment.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡另起一页，请合路所确认上层调查的人手和范围，眼前的通行记录照原来的任务送。

pairs.target: tā xiě dào fèiyòng , tíngbǐ wèn shū yàn , běndì yuē de mùjiàng míngtiān hái lái bu lái .
pairs.english: Writing about costs, he paused to ask Shuyan whether the local carpenter they had booked was still coming tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 他写到费用，停笔问舒砚，本地约的木匠明天还来不来。

pairs.target: " lái . " shū yàn shuō , " lái zhīqián xiān lái zhǎo wǒ yào shàng huí de gōngqián . nǐ yě bié zhī jì cāng xíng yào shénme . "
pairs.english: “Yes,” Shuyan said. “First he'll come to me for his pay from last time. Don't just remember what the warehouse firms want.”
pairs.hanzi: “来。”舒砚说，“来之前先来找我要上回的工钱。你也别只记仓行要什么。”

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shēnshǒu fān qián bó , yù hé xiào zhe jiāng tā cóng tā lìngyìbiān chōuchūlái .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng reached for the account book, while Yuhe laughingly pulled it out from his other side.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡伸手翻钱簿，郁禾笑着将它从他另一边抽出来。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yòu yǒu chē shēng , tǎ wéi xiàyìshí yào qǐshēn , bèi luó dí àn huí dèngzǐ .
pairs.english: Another cart sounded outside the window. Tavi instinctively began to get up, but Luodi pressed him back onto the stool.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外又有车声，塔维下意识要起身，被罗荻按回凳子。

pairs.target: luó dí bǎ liǎnggè mó fàng shàngzhuō , shuō zhè yìhuí shì sòngfàn de , lùpái méi dǎo , xiāngzǐ yě méi kǎ , shuí dōu bùxǔ tì tā duō zhǎo yítàng huó .
pairs.english: Luodi put two buns on the table and said this time it was the food delivery. The sign had not fallen, no crate was stuck, and nobody was allowed to find another job for him.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻把两个馍放上桌，说这一回是送饭的，路牌没倒，箱子也没卡，谁都不许替他多找一趟活。
